name: mm_tax_shield_amortizing_then_permanent_debt_recap
question_template: Use exact arithmetic. An all-equity firm has unlevered value {VU} USD million. At the start of year 1 it issues {B} USD million of debt at par and spends all proceeds repurchasing shares. Interest at {RD} percent per year accrues on the balance at the beginning of each year, is paid at year end and is fully deductible at a {T} percent corporate tax rate. A principal repayment of {A} USD million is paid from operating cash at the end of each of years 1 through {K}; the balance left after the year-{K} repayment is held permanently (inputs leaving a non-positive balance are invalid). Discount each annual shield at the debt rate; once permanent, the shield value equals the tax rate times that balance as of that date. Debt market value equals {B} USD million. Report equity value immediately after the repurchase.

slots.description: Debt balance held permanently after the last scheduled repayment
Present value of interest tax shields during the scheduled repayment years only
Total present value of the debt tax shield at the issue date
Levered firm value at the issue date including the tax shield

program:
from fractions import Fraction

def solve():
    VU = Fraction(P["VU"])
    B = Fraction(P["B"])
    A = Fraction(P["A"])
    K = int(P["K"])
    rd = Fraction(P["RD"]) / 100
    T = Fraction(P["T"]) / 100
    rem = B - K * A
    if rem <= 0:
        raise ValueError("remaining permanent balance must be positive")
    bal = B
    pv_amort = Fraction(0)
    for t in range(1, K + 1):
        shield = T * rd * bal
        pv_amort += shield / (1 + rd) ** t
        bal -= A
    perm_pv = T * rem / (1 + rd) ** K
    ts = pv_amort + perm_pv
    VL = VU + ts
    E = VL - B
    return {
        "final": E,
        "remaining_permanent_balance": rem,
        "amortizing_shield_pv": pv_amort,
        "tax_shield_value": ts,
        "levered_firm_value": VL,
    }
